name: SAIC Motor
verdict: Controlled by the Chinese state-owned SAIC (Group) (63.71%); China has a documented record of serious abuses in Xinjiang.
aliases: 上海汽车集团股份有限公司
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor ('上汽集团') of Shanghai Port FC for the 2026 Chinese Super League season, continuing its long-running deal (Jiefang Daily/Shangguan News, 2026-02-07; its SAIC Roewe brand was on the front in 2025 before Bank of Shanghai). Rating note: proposed 'serious' — the Chinese state controls SAIC Motor through SAIC (Group)'s 63.71% stake (SAIC Motor 2025 annual report), and the UN OHCHR Xinjiang assessment plus Human Rights Watch document serious abuses by that state. Same rating logic as the mg-motor sponsor record.

why.text: SAIC Motor is 63.71% controlled by SAIC (Group), a state-owned enterprise supervised by the Shanghai SASAC, so the Chinese state controls the sponsor. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity.
why.messageLine: SAIC Motor: China's state-owned SAIC (Group) holds 63.71%; the UN has documented serious abuses in Xinjiang.
